title: Adding and Subtracting Fractions and Mixed Numbers
seo_title: Adding and Subtracting Fractions – Primary 5 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Add and subtract fractions with like and unlike denominators, including mixed numbers; solve word problems on fractions. (summary of the NERDC Primary 5 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free Primary 5 maths worksheets on adding and subtracting fractions with the same and different denominators, mixed numbers and fraction word problems. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Add or subtract the numerators only.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • With the same denominator, add or subtract the numerators and keep the denominator: 2/7 + 3/7 = 5/7.
  • With different denominators, change to equivalent fractions using the LCM: 1/2 + 1/3 = 3/6 + 2/6 = 5/6.
  • For mixed numbers, work with the wholes and the fractions, or change to improper fractions first.

Examples

Example

3/4 + 1/6

LCM of 4 and 6 is 12

9/12 + 2/12

Answer: 11/12

Example

2 1/2 − 1 3/4

5/2 − 7/4 = 10/4 − 7/4

Answer: 3/4

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Adding the denominators1/2 + 1/3 is not 2/5.
Forgetting to change both fractionsBoth must have the common denominator.
Leaving an improper answerWrite 9/8 as 1 1/8.

faq.q: Why do the denominators have to be the same?
faq.a: You can only add parts of the same size.

faq.q: How do I find a common denominator?
faq.a: Use the LCM of the denominators.
Yes, always give the answer in its lowest terms.

items.q: The bar is split into sevenths. Green shows 27 and yellow shows 37. What is 27 + 37?
items.e: The denominators are the same. Add the numerators: 2 + 3 = 5. The denominator stays 7. The answer is 57.

items.q: The bar is split into fifths. Green shows 15 and yellow shows 35. What is 15 + 35?
items.e: The denominators are the same. Add the numerators: 1 + 3 = 4. The denominator stays 5. The answer is 45.

items.q: The bar is split into sevenths. The shaded part is 57, and 37 is crossed out. What is 57 − 37?
items.e: The denominators are the same. Subtract the numerators: 5 − 3 = 2. The denominator stays 7. The answer is 27.

items.q: Ada wrote 27 + 37 = 514. What mistake did she make?
items.e: The parts are all sevenths, so the answer is in sevenths too. Add only the numerators: 27 + 37 = 57. She added the denominators as well.

c: 27 + 47
57 − 17

items.e: 27 + 47 = 67. The others make 57, 77 = 1 and 47.

items.q: The bar is split into quarters. Green shows 12 and yellow shows 14. What is 12 + 14?
items.e: 4 is a multiple of 2, so use 4 as the denominator. Write the equivalent fraction: 12 = 24. Add the numerators: 24 + 14 = 34. The answer is 34.

items.q: The bar is split into tenths. Green shows 25 and yellow shows 310. What is 25 + 310?
items.e: 10 is a multiple of 5, so use 10 as the denominator. Write the equivalent fraction: 25 = 410. Add the numerators: 410 + 310 = 710. The answer is 710.

items.q: The bar is split into eighths. The shaded part is 34, and 18 is crossed out. What is 34 − 18?
items.e: 8 is a multiple of 4, so use 8 as the denominator. Write the equivalent fraction: 34 = 68. Subtract the numerators: 68 − 18 = 58. The answer is 58.

items.q:
The bar is split into sixths. The shaded part is 56, and 13 is crossed out. What is 56 − 13?
Give your answer in its simplest form.
items.e: 6 is a multiple of 3, so use 6 as the denominator. Write the equivalent fraction: 13 = 26. Subtract the numerators: 56 − 26 = 36. Simplify: divide the numerator and denominator of 36 by 3 to get 12. The answer is 12.

items.q: The green part is 14 and the yellow part is 38. The dashed lines split the green bar into eighths. How many eighths is the green part?
items.e: Each quarter is split into 2. So 14 = 28: there are 28 in the green part. Now both fractions are in eighths, so you can add or subtract them.

items.q: The green part is 23 and the yellow part is 16. The dashed lines split the green bar into sixths. How many sixths is the green part?
items.e: Each third is split into 2. So 23 = 46: there are 46 in the green part. Now both fractions are in sixths, so you can add or subtract them.

items.q: Which fraction is equal to 35?
items.e: 5 × 2 = 10, so multiply the numerator by 2 too: 3 × 2 = 6. 35 = 610.

items.q: Which fraction is equal to 56?
items.e: 6 × 2 = 12, so multiply the numerator by 2 too: 5 × 2 = 10. 56 = 1012.

items.q:
The bar is cut into sixths. Green shows 12 and yellow shows 13. What is 12 + 13?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: The least common denominator of 2 and 3 is 6. Rewrite: 12 = 36 and 13 = 26. Add the numerators: 36 + 26 = 56. The answer is 56.

items.q:

Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: 8 is a multiple of 4, so use 8 as the common denominator. Rewrite: 14 = 28. Add the numerators: 28 + 38 = 58. The answer is 58.

Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: The least common denominator of 5 and 2 is 10. Rewrite: 25 = 410 and 12 = 510. Add the numerators: 410 + 510 = 910. The answer is 910.

items.q:

Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: 6 is a multiple of 3, so use 6 as the common denominator. Rewrite: 23 = 46. Add the numerators: 16 + 46 = 56. The answer is 56.

items.e: The least common denominator of 4 and 3 is 12. Rewrite: 34 = 912 and 23 = 812. Add the numerators: 912 + 812 = 1712. 1712 is more than 1: 1712 = 1 512. The answer is 1 512.

items.q:

Write the answer as a mixed number in simplest form.

Write the answer as a mixed number in simplest form.
items.e: The least common denominator of 5 and 2 is 10. Rewrite: 45 = 810 and 12 = 510. Add the numerators: 810 + 510 = 1310. 1310 is more than 1: 1310 = 1 310. The answer is 1 310.

items.q:
78 + 34 = ?
Write the answer as a mixed number in simplest form.
items.e: 8 is a multiple of 4, so use 8 as the common denominator. Rewrite: 34 = 68. Add the numerators: 78 + 68 = 138. 138 is more than 1: 138 = 1 58. The answer is 1 58.

items.q:
56 + 512 = ?
Write the answer as a mixed number in simplest form.
items.e: 12 is a multiple of 6, so use 12 as the common denominator. Rewrite: 56 = 1012. Add the numerators: 1012 + 512 = 1512. 1512 is more than 1: 1512 = 1 312. Simplify: divide the top and bottom of 312 by 3 to get 14. The answer is 1 14.

items.q:
12 + 14 + 18 = ?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: Use 8 as the common denominator. Rewrite: 12 = 48 and 14 = 28. Add the numerators: 4 + 2 + 1 = 7. The answer is 78.

items.q: Chiamaka wrote 13 + 14 = 27. What mistake did she make?
c: She added the tops and the bottoms
items.e: Thirds and fourths are different sizes, so you cannot just add the tops and bottoms. Rewrite them as twelfths: 412 + 312 = 712. 27 is even less than 13, so it cannot be the sum.

items.q: 12 + ? = 56
items.e: Think: 56 − 12. Rewrite 12 = 36. Then 56 − 36 = 26 = 13. Check: 12 + 13 = 36 + 26 = 56. The answer is 13.

items.q: 1 25 + 2 15 = ?
items.e: The denominators are the same. Add the fractions: 25 + 15 = 35. Add the whole numbers: 1 + 2 = 3. The answer is 3 35.

items.q: 2 37 + 1 27 = ?
items.e: The denominators are the same. Add the fractions: 37 + 27 = 57. Add the whole numbers: 2 + 1 = 3. The answer is 3 57.

items.q: 1 45 + 1 35 = ?
items.e: The denominators are the same. Add the fractions: 45 + 35 = 75. Add the whole numbers: 1 + 1 = 2. 75 is an improper fraction: 75 = 1 25. 2 + 1 25 = 3 25. The answer is 3 25.

items.q: 2 57 + 1 47 = ?
items.e: The denominators are the same. Add the fractions: 57 + 47 = 97. Add the whole numbers: 2 + 1 = 3. 97 is an improper fraction: 97 = 1 27. 3 + 1 27 = 4 27. The answer is 4 27.

items.q: 1 12 + 2 14 = ?
items.e: 4 is a multiple of 2, so use 4 as the denominator. Write the equivalent fraction: 12 = 24. Add the fractions: 24 + 14 = 34. Add the whole numbers: 1 + 2 = 3. The answer is 3 34.

items.q: 1 15 + 3 110 = ?
items.e: 10 is a multiple of 5, so use 10 as the denominator. Write the equivalent fraction: 15 = 210. Add the fractions: 210 + 110 = 310. Add the whole numbers: 1 + 3 = 4. The answer is 4 310.

items.q: 2 14 + 1 38 = ?
items.e: 8 is a multiple of 4, so use 8 as the denominator. Write the equivalent fraction: 14 = 28. Add the fractions: 28 + 38 = 58. Add the whole numbers: 2 + 1 = 3. The answer is 3 58.

items.q: 1 12 + 2 34 = ?
items.e: 4 is a multiple of 2, so use 4 as the denominator. Write the equivalent fraction: 12 = 24. Add the fractions: 24 + 34 = 54. Add the whole numbers: 1 + 2 = 3. 54 is an improper fraction: 54 = 1 14. 3 + 1 14 = 4 14. The answer is 4 14.

items.q: 2 56 + 1 13 = ?
items.e: 6 is a multiple of 3, so use 6 as the denominator. Write the equivalent fraction: 13 = 26. Add the fractions: 56 + 26 = 76. Add the whole numbers: 2 + 1 = 3. 76 is an improper fraction: 76 = 1 16. 3 + 1 16 = 4 16. The answer is 4 16.

items.q:
3 710 + 1 12 = ?
Give your answer in its simplest form.
items.e: 10 is a multiple of 2, so use 10 as the denominator. Write the equivalent fraction: 12 = 510. Add the fractions: 710 + 510 = 1210. Add the whole numbers: 3 + 1 = 4. 1210 is an improper fraction: 1210 = 1 210. 4 + 1 210 = 5 210. Simplify: divide the numerator and denominator of 210 by 2 to get 15. The answer is 5 15.

items.q: 3 − 38 = ?
items.e: Exchange 1 whole for 88: 3 = 2 88. Subtract the fractions: 88 − 38 = 58. The whole number left is 2. The answer is 2 58.

items.q: 2 − 25 = ?
items.e: Exchange 1 whole for 55: 2 = 1 55. Subtract the fractions: 55 − 25 = 35. The whole number left is 1. The answer is 1 35.

items.q: 4 − 56 = ?
items.e: Exchange 1 whole for 66: 4 = 3 66. Subtract the fractions: 66 − 56 = 16. The whole number left is 3. The answer is 3 16.

items.q: 2 78 − 12 = ?
items.e: 8 is a multiple of 2, so use 8 as the denominator. Write the equivalent fraction: 12 = 48. Subtract the fractions: 78 − 48 = 38. The whole number stays 2. The answer is 2 38.

items.q: 3 14 − 38 = ?
items.e: 8 is a multiple of 4, so use 8 as the denominator. Write the equivalent fraction: 14 = 28. 28 is less than 38, so exchange 1 whole for 88: 3 28 = 2 108. Subtract the fractions: 108 − 38 = 78. The whole number left is 2. The answer is 2 78.

items.q: 5 910 − 2 15 = ?
items.e: 10 is a multiple of 5, so use 10 as the denominator. Write the equivalent fraction: 15 = 210. Subtract the fractions: 910 − 210 = 710. Subtract the whole numbers: 5 − 2 = 3. The answer is 3 710.

items.q: 3 45 − 1 25 = ?
items.e: The denominators are the same. Subtract the fractions: 45 − 25 = 25. Subtract the whole numbers: 3 − 1 = 2. The answer is 2 25.

items.q: 4 15 − 1 35 = ?
items.e: The denominators are the same. 15 is less than 35, so exchange 1 whole for 55: 4 15 = 3 65. Subtract the fractions: 65 − 35 = 35. Subtract the whole numbers: 3 − 1 = 2. The answer is 2 35.

items.q: 5 14 − 2 58 = ?
items.e: 8 is a multiple of 4, so use 8 as the denominator. Write the equivalent fraction: 14 = 28. 28 is less than 58, so exchange 1 whole for 88: 5 28 = 4 108. Subtract the fractions: 108 − 58 = 58. Subtract the whole numbers: 4 − 2 = 2. The answer is 2 58.

items.q:
6 310 − 2 12 = ?
Give your answer in its simplest form.
items.e: 10 is a multiple of 2, so use 10 as the denominator. Write the equivalent fraction: 12 = 510. 310 is less than 510, so exchange 1 whole for 1010: 6 310 = 5 1310. Subtract the fractions: 1310 − 510 = 810. Subtract the whole numbers: 5 − 2 = 3. Simplify: divide the numerator and denominator of 810 by 2 to get 45. The answer is 3 45.

items.q:
A bottle holds 710 litre of juice. Chioma drinks 15 litre. How much juice is left in the bottle?
Give your answer in its simplest form.
items.e: 10 is a multiple of 5, so use 10 as the denominator. Write the equivalent fraction: 15 = 210. Subtract the numerators: 710 − 210 = 510. Simplify: divide the numerator and denominator of 510 by 5 to get 12. The answer is 12 litre.

items.q:
Halima walks 34 km to her friend’s house, then 58 km to the park. How far does she walk altogether?
Give your answer as a mixed number.
items.e: 8 is a multiple of 4, so use 8 as the denominator. Write the equivalent fraction: 34 = 68. Add the numerators: 68 + 58 = 118. 118 is an improper fraction: 118 = 1 38. The answer is 1 38 km.

items.q:
13 of a garden is grass and 16 is a vegetable patch. What fraction of the garden is grass or vegetable patch?
Give your answer in its simplest form.
items.e: 6 is a multiple of 3, so use 6 as the denominator. Write the equivalent fraction: 13 = 26. Add the numerators: 26 + 16 = 36. Simplify: divide the numerator and denominator of 36 by 3 to get 12. The answer is 12.

items.q: In a garden, 25 is lawn and 310 is flower beds. The rest is a patio. What fraction of the garden is patio?
items.e: First add the parts you know. Use tenths: 25 = 410, so 410 + 310 = 710. The whole garden is 1010. Patio: 1010 − 710 = 310.

items.q: Emeka has 2 12 m of ribbon. He uses 34 m to wrap a present. How much ribbon is left?
items.e: 4 is a multiple of 2, so use 4 as the denominator. Write the equivalent fraction: 12 = 24. 24 is less than 34, so exchange 1 whole for 44: 2 24 = 1 64. Subtract the fractions: 64 − 34 = 34. The whole number left is 1. The answer is 1 34 m.

items.q: Uche eats 38 of a pizza and Chinedu eats 14 of it. What fraction of the pizza do they eat altogether?
items.e: 8 is a multiple of 4, so use 8 as the denominator. Write the equivalent fraction: 14 = 28. Add the numerators: 38 + 28 = 58. The answer is 58.

items.q:
Hadiza eats 16 of a cake and Ibrahim eats 13 of it. What fraction of the cake is left?
Give your answer in its simplest form.
items.e: First add what they eat. Use sixths: 13 = 26, so 16 + 26 = 36. The whole cake is 66. Left: 66 − 36 = 36. Simplify: 36 = 12.

items.q:
Blessing spends 34 of an hour on homework and half an hour practising the piano. How long does she spend altogether?
Give your answer as a mixed number.
c: 14 of an hour
23 of an hour
items.e: 4 is a multiple of 2, so use 4 as the denominator. Write the equivalent fraction: 12 = 24. Add the numerators: 34 + 24 = 54. 54 is an improper fraction: 54 = 1 14. The answer is 1 14 hours. (That is 1 hour 15 minutes.)

items.q: Usman runs 1 310 km on Monday and 1 45 km on Tuesday. How far does he run in total?
items.e: 10 is a multiple of 5, so use 10 as the denominator. Write the equivalent fraction: 45 = 810. Add the fractions: 310 + 810 = 1110. Add the whole numbers: 1 + 1 = 2. 1110 is an improper fraction: 1110 = 1 110. 2 + 1 110 = 3 110. The answer is 3 110 km.

items.q: Fatima swims 45 km. Ada swims 710 km. How much further does Fatima swim than Ada?
items.e: “How much further” means subtract. 10 is a multiple of 5, so use 10 as the denominator. Write the equivalent fraction: 45 = 810. Subtract the numerators: 810 − 710 = 110. The answer is 110 km.

items.q: Without finding the exact sum, is 25 + 12 more than 1 or less than 1?
items.e: Use the benchmark 12. 12 + 12 = 1, and 25 is less than 12, so the sum is less than 1. (The exact sum is 910.)

items.q:
A muffin recipe uses 23 cup of flour and 14 cup of sugar. How many cups of flour and sugar is that in all?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: The least common denominator of 3 and 4 is 12. Rewrite: 23 = 812 and 14 = 312. Add the numerators: 812 + 312 = 1112. The answer is 1112 cup.

items.q: Without finding the exact sum, is 58 + 47 more than 1 or less than 1?
items.e: 58 is more than 12, and 47 is more than 12. Two numbers that are each more than 12 add up to more than 1. (The exact sum is 1 1156.)

items.q: Which benchmark is 37 + 18 closest to?
items.e: 37 is close to 12, and 18 is close to 0. So 37 + 18 is about 12 + 0 = 12. (The exact sum is 3156.)

items.q:
Chioma painted 13 of a wall in the morning and 12 of it after lunch. What fraction of the wall is left to paint?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: First add what she painted. Rewrite 13 = 26 and 12 = 36: 26 + 36 = 56. The whole wall is 66. Left: 66 − 56 = 16.

items.q:
A pitcher holds 2 12 litres of lemonade. The class drinks 1 23 litres. How much lemonade is left?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: The least common denominator of 2 and 3 is 6. Rewrite: 2 12 = 2 36 and 1 23 = 1 46. 36 is less than 46, so rename 1 whole: 2 36 = 1 96. Subtract the fractions: 96 − 46 = 56. Subtract the whole numbers: 1 − 1 = 0. The answer is 56 litre.

items.q: Ada added 34 + 15 and got 49. Is her answer reasonable?
c: No. It is less than 34
Yes. It is close to 12
No. It must be more than 1
items.e: 34 alone is more than 49, so 34 + 15 must be more than 34. Ada added the tops and the bottoms. The exact sum is 1520 + 420 = 1920.

items.q:
Esther practiced the piano for 34 hour on Saturday and 23 hour on Sunday. How long did she practice in all?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: The least common denominator of 4 and 3 is 12. Rewrite: 34 = 912 and 23 = 812. Add the numerators: 912 + 812 = 1712. 1712 is more than 1: 1712 = 1 512. The answer is 1 512 hours.

items.q: About how much is 1112 + 78?
items.e: 1112 and 78 are each close to 1. So the sum is about 1 + 1 = 2. (The exact sum is 1 1924.)

items.q:
Amaka's water bottle holds 45 litre of water. She drinks 12 litre during football practice. How much water is left?
Write the answer in simplest form.
items.e: The least common denominator of 5 and 2 is 10. Rewrite: 45 = 810 and 12 = 510. Subtract the numerators: 810 − 510 = 310. The answer is 310 litre.
